column1: # options <TAB> keys <TAB> what the screen must show
# Options, comma separated: restore, context (restore + English context), modern, nospell, vni, simple1, simple2,
# quick, free, zfwj, quickstart, quickend, macro, autocaps, upper. "-" for the defaults.
# Special keys: ⌫ backspace, ↵ enter, ⇥ tab, ⎋ escape, ← left arrow, ¤ mouse click.
# Typing a mark key twice takes the mark off and leaves the letter
# Deleting a letter moves the mark back where it belongs
# Stop consonants only take sắc and nặng
# Restore off: Telex as it always was
# Restore on: words Telex breaks come back as typed
# ...but a doubled letter stays the way to type the shorter, commoner word
# English context: after an English function word, words that are both English and Vietnamese stay English
# Going back into a restored word switches restoring off for it
# Code right after "$", "=", "\" and "`" is typed as is, and so is a unit after a number
# "_", "-" and "/" are not treated as code, Vietnamese uses them too
# Macros look at the whole token, so a name inside an address is left alone
# Quick Telex keeps the capital of the first letter
# Rare key orders that used to type a broken character or eat the one before the word
